Hunter Biden turned his infamous laptop scandal into a meme coin called $LAPTOP, which crashed 98% within an hour.
Evidence: 98% crash, insider token routing, 15k wallets hit
#Aletheia #Crypto

Proponents claimed $LAPTOP was a cultural reclamation project designed to build community, aid charity, and mock political distractions.

In reality, pre-launch insider allocations flooded into market makers while retail traders suffered an immediate 98% wipeout.

The Bright Side:
It lays bare the reckless, hyper-speculative mechanics of celebrity-driven meme tokens for anyone paying attention.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing the Metaphysical WHO (treating political notoriety as a public utility) with financial reality, resulting in an instant liquidity drain.

Social Physics Analysis:
Running a classic Smart Selfish Maneuver. The actor packages personal notoriety behind a righteous pretext of satire, while insiders siphon off early token allocations before retail takes the fall.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. Insiders extract unearned liquidity while retail bears the systemic cost.

The Unavoidable Truth: Speculative meme tokens marketed by public figures inevitably transfer wealth from retail buyers to early insiders.

The Unavoidable Lie: The project was launched as a charitable community builder to reclaim a political symbol.
